answer: Reef echo-sounding bond: each identity moors one echo-sounder on a sable reef, locks 70 bond and files one key-bound serial. Each epoch it pings the floor, logging the echo return time; an auditor recomputes depth from the echo table within 3%; mismatch or a reused serial burns the bond. First 42, k-th 42+6(k-1), 1000th 6,036; 1,000 fakes pay 3,039,000, lock 70,000. Rented reef sounders fail: one trace cannot serve two keys. Honest pay 42 once.
